_doc: band mod (Jauge) settings. Override any key with your own JSON file (userConfig 'config', deep merge; keys starting with _ are ignored). Dollars are list-price ESTIMATES from token counts x these rates.
_count: fresh: input + cache write + output tokens per response (what the model newly processes); all: + cache reads (each call re-reads the cached context, far larger).

gauge._doc: Style of the band above the prompt. compact (default): ONE line, a slim context bar (width px; ticks at the hand-off threshold context.handoff_tokens and at auto-compact, green -> orange -> red) then « ctx 8 % · compact ~16 min · 434 tok/s · 5 h 24 % · sem 14 % » (tok/s of the first scope in `scopes`) and a ▸ that unfolds `sections`. mark_labels: nearest (only the next threshold is named under its tick), all (every label that does not overlap another), none. gauge: the older bar on its own line plus a second line. text: the older single line of band.items. The desktop draws the bar as an Svg, the terminal as text (text_width cells).

sections._doc: Foldable sections under line 1 (style compact). order/enabled: which and in which order (conv = Cette conversation: model · effort, agents running/seen, current Workflow, PR; usage = session 5 h and week bars, this session's $; veille = veille's open alerts, top one; mods = the Mods button row, always unfolded). expanded/open: the state when nothing is remembered (all folded by default). remember: store (kept across sessions in the mod's own $.store) or session. running_s: an agent counts as running when it wrote within this many seconds.

band._items: in order: ctx, compact, relay, idle, rates, week. rates draws one entry per scope listed in scopes.
band._scopes: conv (this conversation, main thread), conv_all (main + its subagents), agents (its subagents and Workflow agents), workflows (its Workflow agents), project (every session in the same repo, worktrees included), all (the PC)

launcher._doc: Mods button bar in the band. One button per item: label shown, mod = folder under mods/ (the plugin name), command = its slash command without the slash, args = what a press passes (optional: « fil » opens /veille fil), key = the open-state id when two buttons share a mod (optional). A press runs /<command> (the mod opens its own pane); a second press, or its ✕, runs /<command> <close_args>. A mod whose command is not in this session greys out. Mods cannot open another mod's pane directly ($.ui.open draws only the caller's own panes), hence the command.

handoff._doc: Hand-off helper, buttons only, nothing runs by itself. An orange line « Passation conseillée » under the band when this conversation's context reaches threshold_tokens (the RESUME rule, 250 K) or the forecast puts auto-compact within eta_min minutes. « Préparer RESUME » runs /<command> <args> (the handoff skill, ~/.claude/skills/handoff); « Ouvrir RESUME » shows the first of files found under the session's folder, then its repo root, in the Jauge pane. history_n: hand-offs and compactions of this conversation listed in the pane.

context._autocompact_pct_fallback: used only when the engine gives no autoCompactThreshold

idle_compact._doc: Compaction at rest (Claude Code 2.1.299): a conversation over min_tokens left inactive about idle_min minutes. Figures from the release notes as relayed, non vérifié in the docs.

labels.launcher_queued: en file : s'ouvre quand Claude a fini son tour
labels.handoff_missing: commande /{command} absente de cette session (skill handoff non chargé)
labels.handoff_queued: en file : se lance quand Claude a fini son tour
labels.handoff_history: Derniers relais et compactages de cette conversation

_shared_lib: auto: per-line usage and prices from mods/usage/lib (its parser and prices.json) when that mod sits beside this one; off: band's own parser and the rates below.
rates_source: Fallback only (shared_lib off or mods/usage absent): USD per million tokens, list prices as in mods/factory/factory.config.json (claude.com/pricing). Cache writes priced at the 5-minute rate.
